name: Tourism Bureaus & Destinations
title: Places to stay and things to do, with booking requests
ask: What is there to do in March, and where can we stay for four nights?
covers: places to stay, activities and tours, when to visit, getting around, events and visitor information
rule: Share only what the bureau has published. Never say a stay or an activity is booked, held or paid: the bureau or its partner confirms every booking. Never take payment or card details in the chat.
who: Tourism bureaus, destination marketing organisations and visitor centres that list partner hotels and activities for one destination. One hotel uses Hospitality & Hotels; one tour operator uses Travel & Tourism.
author: BizPlug

page.headline: Your destination, planned and booked from one chat
page.problem: A visitor planning a trip asks where to stay, what to do and how to book, and gets the answers from ten different sites. A plug-in answers from what your bureau publishes, shows your partner hotels and activities for the visitor's dates, and sends each booking to you to confirm.
valueProps: Stays and activities together::Partner hotels by the night, and activities and transfers priced once for the stay.
Answers from your bureau::When to visit, getting around and events, from the information you publish.
Bookings you confirm::Each request arrives with the dates, the party and what was chosen. On request, bookings continue in your WhatsApp chat instead.
moments: Four nights in March::The partner hotels free for those dates, with the total.
A day on the reef::A snorkel trip for the family, priced per person.
Getting from the airport::Your published transfer options and what they cost.
Is it confirmed?::A reference check instead of an email.
journeys: See stays and activities for the dates
faqs: Is anything booked in the chat?::No. Your bureau or its partner confirms every booking. Availability comes from the dates you publish as taken, not from a live reservation system.

Can bookings go to WhatsApp?::Yes, when it is set up with the BizPlug team: the visitor then gets a link to your WhatsApp chat and the message to send, and you confirm the day, the price and how to pay there. Otherwise requests reach you by email.
